description: This file defines the MonthField class within the Cron namespace. The class encapsulates functionality for handling month-related cron schedule fields, including parsing, validation, and date increment logic for months.

classes.name: MonthField
classes.description: Class for managing the month field in cron scheduling, including validation, satisfaction checking, and date incrementing functionalities.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date satisfies the specified month value, allowing for textual month names.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Moves the given date forward or backward by one month, considering the boundary conditions of calendar months.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the format of the input value for the month field using a regex pattern.
